statement: failed breakout: first through-bar closes beyond L; a close back inside L within the next 3 bars triggers the reversal trade. Stop = extreme since the cross +/- 0.05*ATRd.
mechanism: stop-run/liquidity (A1/A3) or breakout continuation (A2) at HTF levels
falsification: pooled net Sharpe >= 0.5 AND net expectancy > 0 AND >= 60% of instruments with positive net expectancy
